notes.title: Updates Aug 26 Build Version 1.6 Multiplayer Events Steam API New Items
notes.notes:
26 Aug 2015 Current BuildID 750383 

Fixes and new stuff as follows: 

*added two test multiplayer events for teams up to 3.  you can play these events anytime by going to the menu and clicking on events.  A reward item will be granted after the completion of the event.
*adjusted player speed depending on weapons
*added Steam API components which forces naming of character based on steam handle. Works in game.
*can see other players in front of you by pressing "e" when they are close
*optimized some areas
*movement accuracy has been added weapons are no longer pin point accurate
*shortened nights
*turned off camera while loading for slower computers to log in easier
*added daytime only servers
*added mutants

Known bugs and errors 
-adding ability to cook meat 
-Roving raider AI breaks down at times. 
-added more shelter triggers - generally if it rains u need to find cover to prevent the shelter stat from decreasing. Some covered areas might be missing this. Please let me know 
-some item issues with searching containers 
-crafted containers do not save items yet. 
-Storage containers need fixing. 
-Sniper rifles don't zoom properly in first person 
-Players inside vehicles at times don't sync properly 
-Sometimes weapons don't show on first person or are out of place. 
-Sometimes first person and third person conflict 
-At times too many footstep sounds are played 
-Voice chat only works when you tend to spawn near players. 

Let me know of more issues. If you have any issues please let me know. 

Thanks!

notes.title: Updates/Quick Fixes July 8 Build Version 1.4
notes.notes:
Check your build numbers to see what is in the current build. Build numbers are located in properties and then under the tab local files. 

PREVIOUS SAVES ARE NOT COMPATIBLE WITH THIS VERSION 

I changed the way the character saves in order to fix the backpack issue. 

You must reset player on the title screen or have your player get killed for compatibility and certain fixes to work for builds prior to June 16. 

This build may is buggy and may have quite a bit of glitches.  But, I added quite a bit of content.  As follows:

8 July 2015 Current BuildID 688111 

*fixed running over some raiders
*added more roving raiders
*fixed being able to destroy vehicles with gunfire
*added player death dismount on vehicle destruction
*added several more explorable buildings
*added more hit points to vehicles
*more vehicle spawns
*changed length of day 60 minutes = one full day
*spaced out time of weather changes
*fixed two hand weapon use
*fixed drop backpack on death
*no more tree chopping with bare hands - go find an axe
*set up new ports and servers to address network issues
*changed some network configuration and updated network library
*animal spawn in fixed. Animals produce hide and raw meat. Need sharp melee weapon drawn to skin animal.
*simple crafting menu enabled. Not all crafting items work properly. Particular building forts.  Press "V" key to open crafting menu if you have the proper resources.  Press "E" key to place crafted items.  Forts only save on server.  Does not save on single player.
*changed the way to pick up items and search containers. A hand will appear to pick up the item. Press "E" key to pick it up. An indicator will still show that you are near an item. 
*Added last save location.

*fixed bouncy raiders.

**IMPORTANT.  If you have performance issues, ie crashes or low FPS please let me know and I will fix.  I have not tested this new build for performance issues.  

Still working. Didn't make it in.

-adding ability to cook meat
-adding button to separate UI from game world
-Roving raider AI breaks down at times.
-adding name tags for players near
-added more shelter triggers - generally if it rains u need to find cover to prevent the shelter stat from decreasing. Some covered areas might be missing this. Please let me know

Still Need to get to.
-Optional Spawn at last save or town area.
-Storage containers need fixing.
-Sniper rifles don't zoom properly in first person
-Players inside vehicles at times don't sync properly 
-Sometimes weapons don't show on first person or are out of place. 
-Sometimes first person and third person conflict
-At times too many footstep sounds are played 
-Voice chat only works when you tend to spawn near players. 
-Items placed in the bottom panel don't work after save. You have to move them back into the inventory and then back in the panel to get them to work.

Let me know of more issues. If you have any issues please let me know. 

Thanks for everyone's patience.

notes.notes:
Check your build numbers to see what is in the current build. Build numbers are located in properties and then under the tab local files. 

16June 2015 Current BuildID 661897 

-adjusted turning radius on third person.
-fixed lost backpack
-fixed cannot fire bug.
-turned off vsync.  Fantastic settings will now run past 60fps if you have fast hardware.  There may be a bit of tearing and flashes.  Let me know, and I will adjust and make optional.
